title: Steganographic Collusion x Paraphrase Defense Gaps in Multi-Monitor Control

original_idea.body: Set up a two-model hidden-bit channel with a trusted paraphraser between them and measure surviving channel capacity across paraphrase strength levels.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Residual covert-channel capacity after paraphrasing bears on whether untrusted-monitoring protocols are sound.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Sender/receiver channel plus paraphraser, measure surviving bits; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single capacity-vs-paraphrase-strength curve with clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public models, lab-independent, third-party protocol stress-test.

novelty.reasoning: Paraphrase-insufficiency known; the control-pipeline capacity curve may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Steganography-vs-paraphrase studied; the control-pipeline capacity-curve angle may be open.
